entries.headline: Hunter Goodman stayed in the yard
entries.story: Hunter Goodman went 1-for-5 with 2 RBI against Matthew Liberatore and the St. Louis Cardinals. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Cal Raleigh came close
entries.story: Cal Raleigh went 3-for-4 against Jeffrey Springs and the Athletics. Closest call was a double in the 9th: "Cal Raleigh doubles (12) on a line drive to right fielder Lawrence Butler." The power showed up; the carry did not.
